name: skillvortex-extension
description: Biblioteca local e portatil de skills Markdown para projetos e agentes de IA.

skillVortex.vaultPath.description: Caminho compartilhado da biblioteca SkillVortex para os complementos.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p webview/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p extensions/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p extensions/tsconfig.webview.json
scripts.build: tsc && esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --external:vscode --outfile=dist/extension.js && node scripts/build-assets.cjs && vite build --config webview/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:host: npm run build && npm run build:mindcards && npm run build:product-builder && node scripts/test-host.cjs
scripts.package:skillvortex: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out builds/
scripts.package:mindcards: npm run build:mindcards && cd extensions/mindcards && ../../node_modules/.bin/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out ../../builds/
scripts.package:product-builder: npm run build:product-builder && cd extensions/product-builder && ../../node_modules/.bin/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out ../../builds/
scripts.package: npm run package:skillvortex && npm run package:mindcards && npm run package:product-builder
